## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The refactors of `select_cached` and `_select_normalized` behave the same as before. The new `select_failures` does not normalize paths before matching, while the other selectors do, so a report that writes paths with a `./` prefix selects nothing. That should be fixed before merge.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/selection.py:20 — correctness — `select_failures` checks the raw report path against `requested`, so `select_failures({"failed": ["./tests/test_x.py"]}, {"tests/test_x.py"})` returns `[]`. `select_explicit` (line 6) returns `["./tests/test_x.py"]` for the same input, because it keeps the original spelling but compares `normalize(path)`. The new test at tests/test_selection.py:42-44 only uses paths without the prefix, so it can't catch this. Could you change the filter to `if normalize(path) in requested`, which keeps the spelling the docstring promises, and add a test with a `./`-prefixed report entry? — Any runner report that writes paths as `./tests/...` will silently select no failed tests, so failures that should be rerun get skipped without any error.

(none)

## Strengths
- The rewrites of `select_cached` (app/selection.py:9-11) and `_select_normalized` (app/selection.py:14-15) keep the old behavior, and `test_cached_paths_are_normalized_by_caller` checks that cached paths come back normalized.
